mechanism: Establish two original clearly adult-scale opposing figures and one stable confrontation geography. Escalate through at least three fully visible action beats, then at the maximum threshold deliberately replace the picture with an unmistakably authored original interruption card or graphic blackout. Do not depict, describe or infer the missing action. During the ellipse, use only restrained temporal evidence such as distant sound, rain or a counter. Return to the same geography and reveal only observable aftermath states of the same figures and environment. The reusable mechanism is legible buildup, explicit authored censorship-as-ellipsis, non-invention and aftermath reveal—not the source fighters, armor, alley, rain palette, CENSORED word, choreography, hidden content, creator identity or timing.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
